title.value: Substitution of dietary monounsaturated fatty acids from olive oil for saturated fatty acids from lard increases low-density lipoprotein apolipoprotein B-100 fractional catabolic rate in subjects with dyslipidemia associated with insulin resistance: a randomized controlled trial
title.justification: This is the exact title as mentioned at the beginning of the research paper.
title.quote: Substitution of dietary monounsaturated fatty acids from olive oil for saturated fatty acids from lard increases low-density lipoprotein apolipoprotein B-100 fractional catabolic rate in subjects with dyslipidemia associated with insulin resistance: a randomized controlled trial

analysis.description: The paper investigates the effects of substituting dietary monounsaturated fatty acids (MUFAs) from olive oil for saturated fatty acids (SFAs) from lard on lipoprotein metabolism in dyslipidemic individuals associated with insulin resistance through a randomized controlled trial.

type.justification: The paper describes a randomized controlled trial conducted to assess the dietary effects on lipoprotein metabolism, which involves empirical observation and data collection.
type.quote: This study aimed to evaluate the impact of substituting MUFAs for SFAs on the in vivo kinetics of apolipoprotein (apo)B-containing lipoproteins and on the plasma lipidomic profile in adults with IR-induced dyslipidemia.

name.justification: The study focuses on the nutritional intervention examining dietary fat substitution and its effects on metabolic health, specifically in the context of lipoprotein kinetics and plasma lipidomics in subjects with insulin resistance.
name.quote: Objectives: This study aimed to evaluate the impact of substituting MUFAs for SFAs on the in vivo kinetics of apolipoprotein (apo)B-containing lipoproteins and on the plasma lipidomic profile in adults with IR-induced dyslipidemia.
